entries.title: Your first mate starts sooner on a large record
entries.body: Before your first mate starts, the app checks that your saved work comes from a version it understands. It used to copy your whole record twice to do that, which took about a second on a record of a gigabyte. It now checks once, on a copy your Mac makes in a few thousandths of a second.
entries.noPicture: This shortens the wait before the first mate answers; no view looks different.
